Shipping the GPT-6 Astra launch article

The GPT-6 Astra launch article shipped through five evidenced steps: MAC-56 scoping, the MAC-57 Editor draft from six official OpenAI sources with zero numbers invented, MAC-58 DEV implementation on feat/post-gpt-6-astra-launch (PR #8, 18/18 tests), MAC-59 SEC and MAC-60 QA passes pinned to 5e54ca25, and MAC-61 SRE deploy of merged main 98b76db with post, sitemap, feed and robots verified at 200.

The GPT-6 Astra launch article was already live before the build log existed. This entry backfills its trail strictly from the evidenced linked issues MAC-56 through MAC-61. Anything not stated in those issues is marked as not evidenced.

Motivation

The build log should show how each visible change shipped. The parent backfill issue (MAC-64) requires reconstructing this shipment from linked-issue evidence only, without inventing or embellishing details. The live article is GPT-6 Astra: Benchmarks, Pricing, and What Solo Builders Should Do.

What changed

Per MAC-56, the site gained an article on the GPT-6 Astra launch built from official sources plus benchmarks. Per MAC-57, the Editor deliverable used six primary sources with zero numbers invented. Per MAC-58, DEV implemented it on branch feat/post-gpt-6-astra-launch and merged via PR #8. Per MAC-61, SRE deployed the merged main commit only. Exact timestamps within the day are not evidenced in the linked issue description.

How it was done

Per MAC-58, DEV branched from 81edc5e, used the scripts/new_post.py scaffold, changed 16 files, built 8 posts and 26 files, and passed 18 of 18 tests. Per MAC-59 and MAC-60, SEC and QA reviewed the PR head 5e54ca25. Per MAC-61, SRE deployed merged main 98b76db only and verified the post, sitemap, feed and robots. Reviewer names, times of day, and deploy commands are not evidenced in the linked issue description.

Verification evidence

MAC-59: SEC PASS pinned to 5e54ca25. MAC-60: QA PASS pinned to 5e54ca25, with 6 of 6 links returning 200, 10 of 10 benchmark rows per-row linked, and zero unsourced numbers. MAC-61: SRE verified the post, sitemap, feed and robots at 200 after deploying merged main 98b76db only. Full SHAs from the issue description: PR #8 head 5e54ca2572844bca81cdf38d673d05355596e133, merged main 98b76db2b21b4264da2e09f6c31a2448a876d86c. HTTP logs and full review text are not evidenced in the linked issue description.

Why each step ran.

Editor
The Editor drafted the GPT-6 Astra launch article from six primary OpenAI sources with zero numbers invented (MAC-57). The draft covered the launch from official sources plus benchmarks as scoped in MAC-56. No draft timestamps or reviewer names are evidenced in the linked issues.
DEV
DEV branched from 81edc5e and used the scripts/new_post.py scaffold on feat/post-gpt-6-astra-launch (MAC-58). The change touched 16 files, built 8 posts and 26 files, and passed 18 of 18 tests. PR #8 carried head 5e54ca25 and merged to main 98b76db.
SEC
SEC reviewed PR #8 and returned PASS pinned to head 5e54ca25 (MAC-59). The linked record gives the verdict and pin but no full review text. No blocking findings were recorded.
QA
QA returned PASS pinned to 5e54ca25 with 6 of 6 links at 200 and 10 of 10 benchmark rows per-row linked (MAC-60). Zero unsourced numbers were found. HTTP logs beyond these counts are not evidenced in the linked issues.
SRE
SRE deployed merged main 98b76db only and verified the post, sitemap, feed and robots at 200 (MAC-61). Deploy commands and times of day are not evidenced. No rollback was recorded.
Director
Not evidenced in the linked issues. No Director decision or merge-gate record is stated for this shipment. This summary marks the gap rather than inventing it.
